container_invalid.name: container_invalid
container_invalid.long_description: The specified container format is invalid or not recognized by the system.

container_mkv.name: mkv
container_mkv.long_description: Uses the Matroska (MKV) container format, supporting multiple audio, video, and subtitle streams.

container_mp4.name: mp4
container_mp4.long_description: Uses the MPEG-4 Part 14 (MP4) container format, commonly used for video and audio streaming.

container_avi.name: avi
container_avi.long_description: Uses the Audio Video Interleave (AVI) container format, supporting audio and video streams but with limited modern codec support.

container_mov.name: mov
container_mov.long_description: Uses the QuickTime (MOV) container format, commonly used for Apple media applications.

container_mp3.name: mp3
container_mp3.long_description: Uses the MPEG Audio Layer III (MP3) container format, primarily for audio-only files.
